contact.metadataDescription: Having issues? Contact FlyMacro support via tickets, Telegram, or WeChat.
contact.ticketDesc: For account issues, Credit orders, or macro usage questions, submitting a ticket is the fastest way to get a formal response. Our support team typically replies within 24 hours.
contact.telegramDesc: Suitable for English/Chinese communication, fast response.
contact.wechatDesc: Scan the QR code to add our support on WeChat.
contact.faq1: Credits not arriving after purchase? Please confirm the payment is complete. Credits usually arrive within 1-5 minutes. If not received after 10 minutes, please submit a ticket with a payment screenshot.
contact.faq2: Macro code not showing? Please confirm you have redeemed the macro and it hasn't expired. Free macros don't require redemption.
contact.faq3: Auto-renewal failed? The system will attempt to deduct Credits on the expiration date. If there are not enough Credits, auto-renewal stops and you'll be notified. You can manually renew after buying Credits.
contact.faq4: Credit purchases are non-refundable after successful payment. Please read the purchase notice before buying.

about.metadataDescription: FlyMacro provides World of Warcraft AddOn downloads, macro coding guides, free basic macros, and Credit-based macro script redemption.
about.intro: FlyMacro serves World of Warcraft players with AddOn downloads, macro coding guides, free basic macros, and macro script redemption. We help players view in-game action suggestions, learn how macros work, and choose macro scripts that fit their class and specialization.
about.addonBody: The FlyMacro AddOn shows action suggestions and rotation hints inside World of Warcraft, helping players read the current combat flow more clearly. The AddOn is free to download and use.
about.guidesTitle: Macro Coding Guides & Free Basic Macros
about.guidesBody: The website provides macro coding guides for common syntax, setup ideas, and beginner-friendly use cases. Players can also use the free basic macros available on the site.
about.scriptsBody: Some macro scripts are organized by class, specialization, and gameplay scenario. Players can buy Credits and use Credits to redeem the macro scripts they need.
about.creditsBody: Credits are digital points used on FlyMacro to redeem macro scripts. They are not used for in-game trading, game currency, or top-up services.
about.supportBody: For account questions, Credit orders, or macro script support, please submit a ticket from the account center or email us at
